scope: Exploratory reference-contrast predictability over two halves of an exposed five-minute window.

method.projection: Per station/epoch P = I - 11.T/n removes the fitted common clock coordinate.
method.models: zero; common satellite constants; station ENU-direction coefficients; station/satellite constants
method.fitting: Unweighted least squares of projected residuals and features; SVD rcond 1e-12; no target values
method.testing: First five epochs to last six, then last five to first six; coefficients fit on training only
method.interpretation: Coefficients are descriptive, not antenna calibration. Test residuals are clock-free contrasts, not absolute predictions.
method.correlations: Pair means and sample/lag correlations use the whole window descriptively; no population inference.
limitations: short window and limited direction change
antenna, site coordinates, multipath and media are not causally separated
common reference modes and target/reference coupling remain unidentified
